description: Returns the table times on one day and whether a party of this size can be seated at each. Tables can be requested up to two weeks ahead. An empty list means the restaurant is closed that day or the day is out of range.

date.description: The day, as YYYY-MM-DD, on the restaurant clock (Europe/London).

party_size.description: How many people, from 1 to 12. For more than 12, the person should call the restaurant.

name: get_table_availability
title: Free table times
